workResult: Applied Skill 04 only to the three completed same-date Reading Notes. Q-20260903-01 formed the bounded judgment that aligned agent-context and workspace checkpoints are necessary for evaluated long-horizon recovery but do not constitute a complete recovery contract without occurrence-bound authority and reconciliation of effects outside the snapshot boundary. Q-20260903-02 formed the bounded judgment that delegated multi-agent authority should be a stateful authorization program with principal-chain narrowing and composition closure, while preserving the mechanism's dependence on complete policy coverage, serialized admission, trusted enforcement and explicit utility tradeoffs.
